THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: KDS/MDB/4/2/1/64/15. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: L/03/J95/FR/191. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section of the Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, (Amendment) that the Government intend to acquire the following Land which is required for a public purpose. Purpose of Acquisition: Knuckles Range Reservation : An allotment of lad called Angurupolawatta alias Angurukilowatta in total extent of about 0.1621 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 in the preliminary Plan No. Maha 6719 Dated 29.09.2017 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Survey’s - Kandy District, situated in the Village called Mangoda in the Grama Niladhari Division No 806 of Mangoda in the Udasiyapattuwa South Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Medadumbara in Kandy District of the Central Province and morefully described as follows: 1. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Angurupolawatta alias Angurukolawatta; Claimant:W.R.M.Ukkubanda(Passed),Mangoda, Medhamahanuwara; Description: Scrub; Extent0.1621 Hectare. All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/Servitude

hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Medadumbara Divisional Secretariate on the 21st day of February, 2018 at 02.00 p.m. and are hereby requested notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 13th day of February, 2018 the nature of their interest in the aforesaid land/Servitude the particulars of their claims of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. A. M. WICKRAMARACHCHI, Divisional Secretary, Medadumbara. At Divisional Secretariat, Medadumbara, 24th November, 2017.

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

Purpose of Acquisition: Knuckles Range Reservation : An allotment of land called Dhamodara Kele in total extent of about 7.1858 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 in the preliminary Plan No. Maha 6681 Dated 20.07.2017 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Survey’s - Kandy District, situated in the Village called Mangoda in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 806 of Mangoda in the Udasiyapattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Medadumbara in Kandy District of the Central Province and morefully described as follows: 1. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Dhamodara Kele; Claimant: D. R. M. P. B. Rathnayake, R. M. S. B. Rathnayake; Description: Scrub; Extent: 7.1858 Hectares.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/Servitude are hereby required to appear personally, or by agent duly authorized in writing before me at the Medadumbara Divisional Secretariat on the 28th day of February, 2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st day of February, 2018 the nature of their interest in the aforesaid land/Servitude the particulars of their claims of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. A. M. WICKRAMARACHCHI, Divisional Secretary, Medadumbara. At Divisional Secretariat, Medadumbara, 24th November, 2017.
